risk.statement: The synthetic expected-arrival revision warrants human review of the remaining connection window. The backend assesses HIGH connection risk. The AIS-estimated remaining connection window is available. The AIS estimate is available at the scenario cutoff.

deadline.statement: The synthetic expected-arrival revision warrants review of the arrival estimate against the recorded milestone. The backend comparison shows estimated arrival exceeds the applicable transshipment-arrival deadline.

assessment.uncertainty: The synthetic maritime evidence does not establish an actual arrival.
assessment.etaCheck: Ask the carrier operations team to verify whether the latest arrival estimate remains current at the scenario cutoff.
assessment.deadlineCheck: Ask the operations staff to confirm whether the transshipment-arrival deadline remains applicable to the current shipment port.
